summary: Frontend-only regression for 5 Home page edits (NIVORAM): marquee removal, brand-story removal, Instagram→Reviews swap, Featured→Bestsellers rename, Occasions heading rewrite. All 7 structural checks pass. Playwright verified at 1440x900 and 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /app/frontend/src/index.css line 81 still has a stale '/* Marquee */' comment block — harmless but can be cleaned up along with any orphan CSS rules under it.
InstagramFeed.jsx is intentionally retained per agent-to-agent note (future token integration) — acknowledged, not an issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home page structure verified: hero → collections → bestsellers (6 cards, 'Loved in Many Homes', badges present) → occasions (heading 'Make Every Celebration Extraordinary with Nivoram.' with 'Extraordinary' in .text-flame span) → gift-finder-banner → why-nivoram → corporate → reviews (3 cards each with 5 star SVGs) → closing-cta. editorial-marquee absent. 'Born From the Exchange', 'Follow the Studio', 'Brand Story' texts absent. /shop/bestsellers route renders bestseller products. No console/page errors. No horizontal overflow at desktop 1440x900 or mobile 390x844. No Marquee imports in src/. Previous iteration_1 and iteration_2 features (festive mode, image fitting) were not retested per instructions.
